# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as neat, sensible, plain, and pink-cheeked.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Jane is plain, plodding, conscientious, placid, and amiable. Nothing easily rattles her, and she possesses an unshakeable, practical disposition. Though not brilliant, she never says anything to hurt anyone's feelings. She is gamely determined when faced with a challenge, but she can also be opinionated and impressed by high society.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c30 P36](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0036), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

- initially planned to devote her whole life to teaching and never marry for money reasons  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Growing up in Avonlea as the daughter of Harmon Andrews, Jane attended the local school, participated in the childhood Story Club, and joined in games and dares with her playmates. She attended Queen's Academy in the teacher's course, excelling in domestic science. Upon obtaining her license, she began her career teaching school in Newbridge while serving as committee chairman in the Avonlea Voluntary Improvement Society. She later spent time teaching on the western prairies. Before leaving for the West, she acted as a spokesperson on behalf of her brother Billy's romantic interest in Anne Shirley. She eventually returned home to marry Mr. Inglis, a Winnipeg millionaire, and spent her wedding tour travelling to Europe. Despite her wealth, she remained a kind, unaffected friend to her old Avonlea companions.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c12 P10](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0010), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_
